name: hexagon-pattern
title: Hexagon Pattern
blurb: Honeycomb hexagon grid with optional highlighting and orientation.
description: SVG pattern overlay rendering a tessellated hexagon grid. Supports flat-top (horizontal) or pointy-top (vertical) orientation. Can highlight specific hexagons via [col,row] coordinates.
use_when: A sophisticated static hexagon background that needs directional control and selective highlighting.
avoid_when: Many highlighted hexagons — each is a separate SVG polygon element.
a11y: Marked aria-hidden with pointer-events-none; purely decorative overlay.
